templates.name: Scam pattern card
templates.layout: Signal label, one warning phrase, three observable checkpoints, and a reference-action footer.

exampleContent.warningPhrase: I cannot video call, but I need you to invest today.
exampleContent.footer: Pause. Verify independently. Keep account access private.

templates.name: Build log card
templates.layout: Small build number, large shipped change, one why-it-matters line, and one lesson.

exampleContent.whyItMatters: Sensitive details should not leak through a locked interface.
exampleContent.lesson: Access control is a data-flow decision, not a blur effect.

templates.name: Conversation prompt card
templates.layout: A short framing label, one large question, two contrasting answer lanes, and a reply prompt.

exampleContent.label: YOUR READ
exampleContent.question: Which matters more when trust is still new?
exampleContent.footer: Reply A or B — and tell us why.
